issues.detail: The Hebrew says the wife's name is מְהֵיטַבְאֵל (Mehetabel), and her father is מַטְרֵד (Matred), and her grandfather is מֵי זָהָב (Me-zahab). The Vietnamese renders 'Mê-hê-ta-bê-ên' for Mehetabel (correct), 'Mát-rết' for Matred (correct), but then 'Mê-xa-háp' for Me-zahab — this is a different name (Me-zahab is not 'Mê-xa-háp'; the Hebrew 'Mei Zahab' means 'waters of gold' and is a proper name, not 'Mê-xa-háp'). This is a name swap/incorrect rendering of the proper name.
